title: 1st string: E, F and G
summary: Two fretted notes at the top of the staff.

steps.title: Two new notes
text: You know the open 1st string, **E**, in the top space.
One step up is the top line: **F**, at the 1st fret. One more step, sitting on top of the staff, is **G**, at the 3rd fret.

steps.title: Steps on the staff
text: Moving from a space to the next line, or a line to the next space, moves one letter: E, F, G.
On the neck those steps are not all the same size. E to F is one fret. F to G is two.

steps.title: Up and back
text: Use your 1st finger for F and your 3rd finger for G. Say the note names as you play.

steps.title: Skipping around
text: Now with repeats and a skip from E straight to G. Read each note from the staff, not from memory.

steps.title: E, F and G
text: Four bars on the 1st string. The finger numbers show only at the start of each bar.
